# Archived upstream workflows

These original workflow files are retained for reference outside
`.github/workflows/`. GitHub Actions does not discover or run them here.

They cover the upstream hosted deployments and cleanup, mobile E2E, sandbox,
issue/PR automation, scheduled canary and automatic desktop/CLI/Homebrew
releases. They are not active Remix automation. Do not restore them or their
automatic triggers during an upstream sync without an explicit user request.

The fork retains manual CI and the manual Remix preview entry point, plus
their reusable build definitions. See [workflow policy](../../docs/workflow-policy.md).
